subject: Security walkthrough: evening window for SOC 2 & DPA + pen-test scope
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@finco.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: security_ops@finco.com
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough + pen-test scope — availability

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We are ramping toward our SOC 2 intake and need a combined walkthrough to cover your SOC posture, DPA clauses, and to agree high-level pen-test scope. Ideally we'd do a single session that F20 security and our infra team can attend.

Our constraints: we have a major release Tuesday morning (US PST) that makes daytime windows tight. Could you share evening availability (US PST) on Mon/Tue/Thu next week? Prefer 90 minutes, and we'll provide a list of attendees.

I've attached a short intake checklist and our standard evidence request template. Also linking our security intake form: https://forms.finco.com/security-intake/1242

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Security Engineer, FinCo
security@finco.com

Attachments: finco-intake-checklist.pdf (pdf), evidence-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@finco.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough + pen-test scope — availability

Hi Elena — great to hear from you and congrats on the release week.

We can definitely combine SOC 2, DPA review, and a scoping conversation for the pen-test. Suggested windows (PST):
- Monday 2026-07-06, 18:00–19:30 (90m)
- Tuesday 2026-07-07, 19:00–20:30 (90m) — I know this is tight with your release but could work after ops finishes.

I'm looping in Kimberly (cc) who owns evidence handoff and the DPA details on our side — she can confirm what artifacts we can produce before the meeting and what needs a follow-up. We'll propose an ops bridge if you need our infra/ops engineer to join.

I attached a draft pen-test scope we typically use and a calendar invite stub — happy to adjust timing. If evenings are still impossible, we can propose an APAC-friendly late-afternoon alternative (Wed 07/08 16:30–18:00 PDT / Thu morning APAC).

Next steps: pick a preferred slot and share attendee list + specific pen-test goals (external network vs. blackbox app, etc.).

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 415-555-0199

Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough + pen-test scope — availability

On Mon, Jul 4, 2026 at 11:03 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> We're looping in Kimberly (cc) who owns evidence handoff and the DPA details on our side — she can confirm what artifacts we can produce before the meeting and what needs a follow-up.

Thanks Marcus — really helpful. The Tuesday evening slot conflicts with a post-release review we cannot move. Monday 18:00–19:30 PST works for us but can we shorten to 75 minutes? Our infra lead needs to join for the pen-test scoping portion only (first 30–40 minutes).

Attendees: Elena Ortiz (security), Miguel Torres (infra), Anna Reed (compliance). We'll need the DPA contact to confirm the data retention questions up front.

Two asks before the call:
1) Can you share a mapping of which SOC 2 controls you expect to cover in a single session vs. follow-up?
2) Please confirm whether you support on-demand evidence extraction or if evidence must be pulled manually by your team (we asked in the intake form but thought you'd have clarification).

We'll also attach a short SFTP checklist if we need to share sample logs.

Best,
Elena

Attachments: finco-sftp-checklist.txt (text)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@finco.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, security_ops@finco.com
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 18:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough + pen-test scope — availability

Elena — thanks for confirming the attendee list and the Monday slot. Confirmed: Monday 2026-07-06 18:00–19:15 PST (75 minutes). I'll send the calendar invite and include a 30-minute pen-test scoping segment at the top of the agenda so Miguel can join just for that portion.

Quick answers to your pre-call asks:
1) Scope mapping (high level):
- In-call (what we'll cover): access controls (CC6), change management overview (CC3), incident response overview (CC7), data location & retention summary tied to the DPA, and pen-test high-level constraints.
- Follow-up (artifacts / deep dives): detailed control evidence (system configs, audit logs), application-level logging samples, and full SOC2 control matrices where needed.

2) Evidence extraction: we support a hybrid model — automated exports for common artifacts (audit logs, user activity, KV cache metrics) plus manual pulls for bespoke configs or vendor attachments. Kimberly will include exact timelines in the invite so you know what can be delivered pre-call vs. within the attestation window.

Action items before the meeting:
- Marcus: send calendar invite and pen-test scope final draft (attached).
- Kimberly: attach evidence matrix and list of artifacts we can auto-export.
- Elena: share SFTP checklist and final attendee list.

If anything changes for the release, ping me and we can move to the Wednesday APAC-friendly alternative. See you Monday.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)
